rules.text: All gear must be returned within 60 days of purchase.
rules.quote: All gear must be returned within 60 days of purchase

rules.text: Holiday return policy is extended to 90 days for orders placed between November 1 and December 31.
rules.quote: Typically we extend our holiday return policy from 60 to 90 days for all orders placed between November 1 and December 31st.

rules.text: Gear cannot be worn, used, washed, altered, or opened to be eligible for return.
rules.quote: Gear cannot be worn, used, washed, altered, or opened

rules.text: Gear cannot be returned for personal reasons unrelated to product performance or satisfaction.
rules.quote: Gear cannot be returned for personal reasons unrelated to product performance or satisfaction

rules.text: Footwear must include the original shoe box in its original condition for returns.
rules.quote: Footwear must include the original shoe box in its original condition

rules.text: Gear purchased in-store must be returned in the country purchased.
rules.quote: Gear purchased in-store must be returned in the country purchased (E.g., Gear purchased in the US cannot be returned in Canada)

rules.text: All gear must have proof of purchase to be returned or exchanged.
rules.quote: All gear must have proof of purchase

rules.text: Allow up to 14 business days for online refunds to be posted after return is processed.
rules.quote: Please allow up to 14 business days for your refund to be posted.

rules.text: Exchanges for size or color are allowed within 60 days of purchase through UA.com or in-store with proof of purchase.
rules.quote: We’re happy to offer size/color exchanges through UA.com within 60 days of purchase.
